vault.title: Pūtaka Whaiaro
vault.subtitle: He wāhi whaiaro ka wetekina anake i roto i te kaitirotiro, ā, kāore e taea te pānui e te tūmau hei kuputuhi māmā.
vault.setup_description: Ka huaia te kī o te pūtaka i roto i te kaitirotiro. Ka penapenahia e te tūmau te kī kua āta pōkaihia me ngā tuhinga kua whēkaina anake.
vault.setup_warning: Mēnā ka ngaro atu ō kupuhipa pātaka me te kī whakaora, kāore e taea te whakahoki i ngā raraunga.
vault.passphrase_placeholder: Kōwhiria he kupuhipa kaha me te iti rawa o 12 pūāhua
vault.protection_title: He aha te ārai i tēnei?
vault.protection_item_1: Ko te ingoa o te tūemi, te whakamārama, te waehere pa, te utu, te rā, me ngā mara tiwhikete kua huna i te pūtirotiro.
vault.protection_item_2: E kite noa ana te tūmau i te pūrua huna, te tatauranga tūemi, me ngā wā rānei.
vault.protection_item_3: Ko te tukunga tuatahi he whaiaro, ā, e aro ana ki te kuputuhi; e hiahia ana ngā tohatoha me ngā pāpāho i tētahi rerenga haumaru motuhake.
vault.unlock_description: Ka taea e koe te whakatuwhera i te putunga mā tō kupuhipa, mā te kī whakaora rānei i whakaritehia e koe i mua.
vault.unlocking: E whakatuwhera ana te pouaka huna...
vault.security_note_1: Kei te noho te kī o te pouaka huna i roto i te mahara pūtirotiro anake. Ka mukua ana koe i te whārangi, ka whati katoa te pouaka huna.
vault.security_note_2: Mehemea ka wareware koe i te kupuhipa, ka taea e koe te whakamahi i te kī whakaora. Mēnā ka ngaro hōrua, ka kore e taea te whai i te ihirangi mō ake tonu atu.
vault.recovery_ready_description: Ka whakaatuake mātou i tēnei kī kotahi anake. Tiakina ki tētahi wāhi haumaru.
vault.recovery_visible_once: Kāore e whakaatuhia anō tēnei kī ā muri ake nei.
vault.record_form_subtitle: E pā ana tēnei ki te rere o ngā tūemi noa iho, engari kāore te kuputuhi ma te mārama e wehe i te kaitirotiro.
vault.barcode_privacy_hint: Kāore e tirotirohia ngā pāteke ā-pouaka i ngā ratonga o waho ā-ringa; kua penapenahia te kuputuhi pāteke hei raraunga hōmi katoa.

vault.delete_confirm: Kei te tino pākiki koe e hiahia ana ki te muku i tēnei rekord pātū?

preview.title: Aratau arotake
preview.body: Ko te taha papamuri o tēnei whārangi kāore e taea te toro i te wā whakamātautau ā-rohe ināianei. Ka taea tonu e koe te arotake i te āhua me te rerenga tuatahi; ka whakahohe mātou i te taha tūmau ā muri i tō whakaaetanga.

legal.privacy_policy_content: He mea nui ki a mātou tō noho matatapu. Ka tiakina e tēnei taupānga ō raraunga kua tuku haumaru mā te kīanga ā-papakōrero. Kāore mātou e hoko, e tiri rānei i ō raraunga whaiaro ki ētahi atu rōpū. Mā te whakamahi i te ratonga, ka whakaae koe ki te kohikohi i ngā raraunga e hiahiatia ana mō te whakahaere kaute me te mahi o te taupānga.
legal.terms_of_service_content: Mā te whakamahi i te {{brandName}}, ka whakaae koe ki ēnei tikanga. Ka tukuna te ratonga 'pērā tonu' kāore he whakamana. Ko koe te kawenga mō ngā raraunga ka tuku koe me te whakarite kei a koe ngā tika ki aua raraunga. Kei a mātou te mana ki te whakatā i ngā kaute e takahi ana i ngā kaupapa here, e tāhae rānei i te pūnaha.
legal.register_consent: Kua pānui, kua mārama, ā, e whakaae ana ahau ki te <1>Ngā Kaupapa Ratonga</1> me te <2>Ngā Kaupapa Matatapu</2>.
legal.consent_subtitle: Tēnā, whakauhia ngā kaupapa o nāianei i mua i te haere tonu.
legal.consent_notice: Me whai tātou i tētahi tautuhinga tuhi hei whakamana i ngā Kaupapa Whakamahinga me te Panui Matatapu i mua i tō taea ki te whakamahi tonutia i te taupānga.
legal.consent_checkbox: Whakaae ahau ki ngā Kaupapa Whakamahinga, ā, e whakau ana ahau kua pānui au i te Panui Matatapu.
legal.consent_required: Me whakamana e koe ngā Kaupapa Whakamahi me te Panui Kūmata i mua i te haere tonu.

cookies.banner_text: Ka whakamahia e mātou ngā kōkī e tika ana hei pupuri i a koe i te takiuru me te haumaru o tō wātaka. Mā te haere tonu ki te whakamahi i tēnei pae, e whakaae ana koe ki ā mātou kaupapa here.
